failure_modes: no storage -> throws, refuses to operate blind
defining a prompt twice -> hard error (SISO Design Law 1, never silent precedence)
custom over 120 chars -> throws, naming the limit
multiple values on a single-select prompt -> throws
skipping an allowSkip:false prompt -> throws, and the message says reconsider
invariants: every declared prompt offers Other — there is no per-prompt opt-out
allowSkip defaults TRUE; a skip records null, never a default and never the first option
custom options are offered FIRST next time
customs are private unless share:true is passed explicitly
§0.3 remove() archives, restore() brings it back
§1.1 an unknown value is recorded as written, never normalised onto a canonical option
why: A closed list is a claim about what a person is allowed to feel. Handed 62 options and none of them right, the common response is to pick the nearest wrong one, which silently corrupts every derivation downstream. A confidently-recorded wrong value is worse than an absent one (§1.2).
status: implemented — 15/15 choice assertions. Phase G retrofit of the remaining prompts is open.
